description: Titles whose text is laid out in several boxes: each word an inline block, words as flex items, two lines around a forced line break, and a title that shares its row with a small link. Boxes of one style that sit a word space apart on one line inside one parent are one block, so each title is one likely finding on its parent, with its words separated by spaces (e2e/headings.spec.ts checks the text). A row of peers set further apart is not merged and not reported.
